title: Add a slide of your own
subtitle: A new folder, then one line in presentation.json
bullets: First make the folder `my-slide` beside this slide's folder, with a `content.json` holding the text on the right
Then add `"my-slide"` to a section's `slides` list in the file below
List a slide only once its file exists: a deck that names a missing slide shows an error page that says so
task: Create the slide's file first, then list it. It appears in the deck where you listed it.
ask: In the tutorial deck, add a new content slide with the id my-slide, right after task-new-slide.
whenDone: Press O to see it among the others.
